description: You shift yourself through new timelines #selflove #lifetips #timelinejump
transcript: I move through timelines consistently and constantly because I stand on business. I do exactly what I say that I'm going to do the first time. I do not repeat myself, not wait for feedback. I know who I am and I know where I sit at the table. My placement in this world is not a surprise to me. I am not easily moved. I live in reality because I understand the power that I have to move. I don't stay anywhere longer than necessary. I don't pour into cups that have a hole in the bottom.
